Remark
[Green's function and the Dirac measure] ↗ def:greens-function 1. ch2:2.2.4-rem-3\group Green’s Functions

For fixed $x\in U$, Green's function satisfies symbolically \[ -\Delta _yG(x,\cdot )=\delta _x\ \text{in }U, \qquad G(x,\cdot )=0\ \text{on }\partial U. \]
